'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Islamic terrorism in Europe]]
**[[Arras school stabbing]]
***A teacher is killed and another teacher and a [[security guard]] are seriously injured in a stabbing attack at a [[high school]] in [[Arras]], [[Hauts-de-France]], [[France]]. The [[Chechens|Chechen]] attacker is arrested by police. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-67101089 (BBC News)]
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**[[Israel–Hamas war]]
***[[Evacuations during the Israel–Hamas war]]
****The [[Israeli Defense Forces]] notifies the [[United Nations]] that the 1.1 million [[Palestinians]] living north of [[Wadi Gaza]] in the [[Gaza Strip]] have been ordered to relocate to Southern Gaza within 24 hours ahead of an expected ground [[invasion]]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/idf-warns-palestinians-in-northern-gaza-to-evacuate-within-24-hours-un/ (Times of Israel)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/now-is-time-war-says-israels-military-chief-2023-10-12/ (Reuters)]
****The [[Israeli Air Force]] begins dropping [[emergency evacuation|evacuation]] leaflets over [[Gaza City]] warning residents to leave the city immediately. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/world-middle-east-67096916 (BBC News)]
****[[Hamas]] tells Palestinians to remain in their houses and not to relocate to Southern Gaza, despite [[Israel]]i orders to do so. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/hamas-tells-gazans-not-to-evacuate/ (Times of Israel)]
****The [[United Kingdom]] begins evacuating [[British nationality law|British citizens]] from [[Israel]]. [https://www.euronews.com/2023/10/12/gaza-engulfed-by-humanitarian-crisis-as-safe-corridor-rejected (Euronews)]
***[[2023 Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip]]
****Israeli troops conduct "localized raids" into Gaza in an attempt to locate Hamas-held hostages. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog-october-13-2023/ (Times of Israel)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/now-is-time-war-says-israels-military-chief-2023-10-12/ (Reuters)]
***At a [[press conference]], [[Ministry of Defense (Israel)|Israeli Defense Minister]] [[Yoav Gallant]] says that the main goal of the upcoming military operation will be to "topple [[Governance of the Gaza Strip|Hamas rule]] in Gaza". [https://www.axios.com/2023/10/13/israel-us-hamas-austin (Axios)]
***Israeli soldiers open fire against [[Israel–Hamas war protests|protestors]] in the occupied [[West Bank]], killing eleven people and injuring 124 others. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/10/13/israel-hamas-live-iran-says-new-fronts-may-open-if-gaza-bombing-continues (Al Jazeera)]
***[[Human Rights Watch]] accuses the Israeli Defense Forces of using [[white phosphorus munitions]] in its [[military operation]] in the Gaza area and [[Lebanon]], saying that this puts [[civilian]]s at risk of serious and long-term injuries. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/human-rights-watch-says-israel-used-white-phosphorous-gaza-lebanon-2023-10-12/ (Reuters)]
***[[Hamas]] says that 13 [[hostage]]s, including foreigners, have been killed in Israeli [[airstrike]]s. [https://www.wionews.com/world/hamas-claims-israeli-strikes-kill-13-hostages-including-foreigners-in-gaza-646271 (WION)]
***An Israeli [[missile]] strike hits a group of journalists on the Lebanese side of the border with Israel, injuring six of them, and killing a [[Reuters]] videographer, [[Issam Abdallah]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/reuters-videographer-killed-southern-lebanon-2023-10-13/ (Reuters)]
**[[2024 Iran–Israel conflict]], [[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
***[[Reuters]] photojournalists [[Issam Abdallah]] killed, Christina Assi critically injured and five journalist of [[Agence France Presse|AFP]] and [[Al Jazeera Media Network|Al Jazeera]] injured  by two IDF tank shells when documenting an IDF outpost in [[southern Lebanon]].[https://www.reuters.com/graphics/ISRAEL-LEBANON/JOURNALIST/akveabxrzvr/ (Reuters)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Battle of Avdiivka (2022–present)|Battle of Avdiivka]]
***Heavy fighting occurs between [[Ukrainian Ground Forces|Ukrainian]] and [[Russian Ground Forces|Russian forces]] for control of [[Avdiivka]] in [[Donetsk Oblast]]. [[Ukraine]] says that [[Russia]] has launched [[airstrike]]s and [[artillery]] attacks on the city overnight but that its troops were "holding their ground". [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-pummels-east-ukrainian-town-avdiivka-heavy-fighting-2023-10-13/ (Reuters)]
*A [[diplomat]] at the Embassy of Israel in [[Beijing]], [[China]], is stabbed by an unknown foreign attacker. The diplomat was taken to a hospital for treatment and is in stable condition. The incident is being treated as a [[terrorist]] attack. [https://www.i24news.tv/en/news/israel/1697184222-israeli-diplomat-stabbed-in-beijing-in-possible-terrorist-attack (i24 News)]

*Seven people are killed and 15 are injured after a [[suicide bombing]] at a mosque in [[Puli Khumri]], [[Baghlan Province]], [[Afghanistan]]. [https://www.rferl.org/amp/afghanistan-mosque-bombing-friday-prayers/32636187.html (RFE/RL)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[International reactions to the Israel–Hamas war]]
**[[Germany|German]] [[literary society]] [[LitProm]] postpones a ceremony at the [[Frankfurt Book Fair]] honoring [[Palestinian literature|Palestinian author]] [[Adania Shibli]] with the LiBeraturpreis award following the war. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/oct/15/palestinian-voices-shut-down-at-frankfurt-book-fair-say-authors (''The Guardian'')]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Acquisition of Activision Blizzard by Microsoft]]
**The UK's [[Competition and Markets Authority]] approves [[Microsoft]]'s [[takeover]] of [[video game industry|video game company]] [[Activision Blizzard]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-67080391 (BBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Mühldorf van crash]]
**Seven people are killed and 16 others are injured when a vehicle carrying [[illegal immigrant]]s from the [[Middle East]] [[traffic collision|crashes]] in [[Mühldorf (district)|Mühldorf]], [[Bavaria]], Germany. [https://apnews.com/article/germany-highway-crash-migration-913150133da16774defb08eb53d29f41 (AP)]
*A [[military helicopter]] crashes in [[Canelas Municipality]], [[Durango]], [[Mexico]], killing three people. [https://apnews.com/article/mexico-military-helicopter-crash-d26393068c7594ca4ac51fc07216ccf7 (AP)]

'''Health and environment'''
*The [[United States]]' [[National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration]] reports a 99% likelihood of 2023 becoming [[Instrumental temperature record|the warmest year on record]]. [https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2023/10/14/world/science-health/2023-record-hottest-year-us/ (AFP via ''The Japan Times'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[International reactions to the Israel–Hamas war]]
**During a [[Commonwealth of Independent States|CIS Summit]] in [[Bishkek]], [[Kyrgyzstan]], [[President of Russia|Russian President]] [[Vladimir Putin]] says that [[Russia]] will offer to mediate a ceasefire. [https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2023/10/13/putin-says-russia-ready-to-mediate-israel-hamas-war-a82758 (''The Moscow Times'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Israel–Hamas war protests]]
**Anti-[[Israel]] protests occur in many cities across the [[Middle East]]. [https://apnews.com/article/israel-palestinians-hamas-war-friday-prayers-mideast-8474ed730294a1c2299bdaef58a17142 (AP)]
**Cities across the United States tighten their security after former [[Hamas]] leader [[Khaled Mashal]] called for a [[Global Day of Jihad]] against [[Zionism]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2023/oct/13/police-security-protests-israel-hamas (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Russian police]] detain one of the three lawyers of [[Alexei Navalny]] and raid the houses of the other two, accusing them of belonging to an [[extremist]] organization. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/investigators-search-homes-three-navalnys-lawyers-allies-say-2023-10-13/ (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[October 2023 Speaker of the United States House of Representatives election]]
**[[Jim Jordan]] wins the [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] nomination for [[Speaker of the United States House of Representatives|House Speaker]] after [[Steve Scalise]] withdrew his bid. [https://www.axios.com/2023/10/13/jim-jordan-house-republican-speaker-nominee (Axios)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Discovery Program]]
**[[NASA]] successfully launches its [[Psyche (spacecraft)|Psyche]] [[uncrewed spacecraft|space probe]] from [[Kennedy Space Center]]. The spacecraft will explore the [[M-type asteroid]] [[16 Psyche]], a suspected core of a [[protoplanet]] in the [[asteroid belt]]. [https://www.reuters.com/technology/space/nasa-set-launch-spacecraft-explore-metal-rich-asteroid-psyche-2023-10-13/ (Reuters)]
